packets.title: q0_verify.py consolidated executable verification layer (48 embedded q0 instruments, C-CONS-2026-07-19)
packets.summary: Single 957 KB script embedding, byte-verbatim in base64, 48 Python instruments of the 488-file q0 archive plus a reconstructed q0_llm_verifier_v3 shim. The mathematical members include the C095 exact six-pin conditional covariance factorization for the periodized Bargmann-Fock field, the C096 BR-MARK limit scan, the C098 Gamma maxcount benchmark, the C099 cubic type no-go, the C100/C101 collar and window-saddle frames, C104 coupled persistence, the c019-c027 Kac-Rice/Lambda instruments, Lemma P, the Palm-weighted Gaussian Chernoff theorem and the Gaussian corridor certificate. The other members are gate/verifier tooling and release scripts.

packets.title: Q0 Rate Program theorem contracts C091-C101: 1-q(r,6/5)<=C r^3 and lim q=1 for the exact periodized BF field on T_24^2
packets.summary: Gate-kernel-2.0 claim contracts for the typed maximum-saddle pair-Palm law at L=24, b=6/5, 0<r<=0.025. The pairing defect is decomposed into an interceptor event, a Gamma event and collar residues by a union bound. C096 proves the cubic rate and the q limit modulo three residual conditions. C097 reduces Gamma to seven chart/Malliavin obligations. C098 replaces that route with an exact pair-Palm maximum-window Kac-Rice count, closing the exterior. C101 marks all conditions PROVEN at internal program grade, with SARD-G external review pending and no numeric coefficient claimed. C091 records the proof-gate reduction: a closed-exact one-sided interpolation lemma, the H4 q-step product killed, and forbidden decimal promotions.

Sources cited: C090, C094-UBG-CORRECTION, C096-UBG-RESIDUAL-AUDIT. Root hashes: 90d517d1/a8a9cd71 (C096), ca35af0d/df159796 (C098), f92e4aae/5ed20eaf (C101). Cycle state ledgers are idx 9-12. The kernel reports in 05_CONTRACT_REPORTS are not in this batch. No comment_census_rows or impl_sourcing_rows.

It verifies that the 6-pin conditional covariance of the free 2-/3-jets is diag(2,2,2,6) with E[f_yy|pins]=-b, that the 3x3 scaled-frame covariance has determinant s^8(c^2+s^2)(3c^2+s^2)/24, the v11/v22 variance identities, and the rho-series of the three-station Hessian product, each with negative controls. The final assert at L43 is vacuous.

packets.summary: Proves the same-k gluing lemma and that the k-AP-free harmonic supremum C_k equals the supremum of prime-base digital sums, with an exact summation method. Proves that Walker's base-11 alphabet dominates every adaptive base-11 digit tree, using a 1024-case finite certificate.

packets.summary: C8 reviewed PROOF.md (blob 86371a58, sha abed6f94) and EVERYWHERE_MARK_EXTENSION.md (blob 7b60528b) §§2-9 and gave PASS_SCOPED with no must-fix and non-blocking notes N1-N4. packets.title: CapFirstExit Lean: topological first-exit step from separating cap to elder level (leancap/CapFirstExit.lean)
packets.summary: Defines CapHyp (C1-C3, saddle form C2+) on an arbitrary topological space and proves path_meets_frontier, barrier, maximin_isGreatest/maximin_eq, component separation/joining, elder_merge_iff and elder_death_level. A one-dimensional toy shows CapHyp can be satisfied and that dropping C1, C2 or C3 breaks the maximin conclusion. No sorry.
packets.already_accounted_hint: Version of Math- frontiers/cap_first_exit_lean_20261002/CapFirstExit.lean; recovery map matches other session copies at Math- PR #200/#271. Cites reviews/d1_cap_elder_partner_second_pass_claude_20260930/REVIEW.md L16-L20. Axiom audit leancap/AxiomCheck.lean is index 14.

packets.title: CapFirstExit partial-block and torus extension Lean drafts (lean25 S1-S3, lean26 S1-S2)
packets.summary: Proves that the third Frechet derivative is symmetric, gives a trilinear bound from three partial derivative blocks (block_of_partial), and derives ridge_capHyp_blocks, the cap hypotheses from block bounds on f, with a mixed toy. lean26 carries this over to the flat torus (torus_capHyp_blocks, torus_elder_death_level_blocks) and proves a concrete instance, torusToy_elder. Drafts import CapFirstExit and have no sorry; the S1 and S2 fragments print axioms of names they do not define.
packets.already_accounted_hint: Built on CapFirstExit (ridge_capHyp_K, CapHyp.olderPeakLevels); related to the Math- PR #257-#260 CapFirstExit stack (kreplies, indices 0-7). Axiom stub lean25/ax.lean is index 11.

packets.summary: Hand re-derivation, six check passes and adversarial verification confirm P1, P3 and P6-P22 of the accepted conditional protocol contract on Math-#193, with nothing blocking. Five material amendments: M1 a P5-free sample-side bridge, M2 a pre-data width envelope for P22, M3 the eta^-4 floor n>=1,042,568 ln(2J/alpha) on the P13 route, M4 per-bin Q_j/r_j, and M5 adding the SIDE24 enclosure, with C_alg(2,24)=c_{2,inf}(1-2.18e-118). The scripts are the sympy, mpmath and exact-rational evidence.

packets.title: Math-#193 frozen NUM moment kernel, cross-family input M193-KERNEL-XFAM-INPUT-01CZ-20261018: result verdict
packets.summary: CONCUR_WITH_NOTES on the frozen moment-enclosure kernel (freeze d4b80304). It reports reproduction confirmed, 0 non-containments against independent mpmath sums, rejection of every falsifying tampering, and a 10-item soundness audit passed. Notes cover absolute-width lower bounds at small L, beta well conditioned vs nu3 cancelling, and TEST_ONLY not being enforced in code.

packets.title: Kernel containment checks: mpmath reference sums vs certified z, mu2, mu4, mu6 enclosures (kernel_input scripts_containment, work_soundness/probe, captured runs)
packets.summary: An independent reference (direct lattice sum with a rigorous tail bound, plus a Poisson-dual Hermite series agreeing to 1e-129) for z_L and mu_2k of the discrete Gaussian on (2pi/L)Z. Kernel certificates contain it: 295 sweep and 200 random certificates, 0 failures over thousands of samples. Pi/exp enclosures, tail bounds and checker-minimal boundary certificates are also checked.
packets.already_accounted_hint: Supports Math-#193 result 6244357886 §2-3; comment_census_rows ? on files 48, 49, 57, 90, 91, 94

packets.title: Kernel cancellation and conditioning analysis: beta=b-a^2, nu3=c-b^2/a, kappa4, kappa6 and small-L positivity (work_cancellation, lens_b, verify_scripts, verify_out)
packets.summary: Componentwise condition numbers at the ORIGINAL weights: beta amplifies by at most 10^0.40, while nu3 amplifies by 10^101.9 at L=1/2 (10^284.8 at L=0.3). Cancellation-free double-sum forms amplify by about 10^0.7/10^0.86, and their identities check to about 1e-500. Certified mu2_lo>0 first appears at L=0.60 (80 bits) and L=0.48 (128 bits).

packets.title: TEST_ONLY checker-minimal boundary certificates for the NUM moment kernel (work_containment/tight)
packets.summary: Eleven distinct-path TEST_ONLY interval certificates (the README's 12, one duplicated at 106_128.json) built by tighten.py. Each enclosure is the exact forward image the checker demands, rounded only to the 2^-bits grid, for z, mu2, mu4, mu6 at point and interval L from 7/400 to 30. All are accepted, and all contain the mpmath reference. No scientific target.

packets.title: Math-#193 finite-L/GAD coefficient proof, cross-family input M193-GAD-XFAM-INPUT-01CZ-20261017: checkpoint, draft and posted result
packets.summary: CONCUR_WITH_NOTES on the frozen finite-L/GAD coefficient proof (6243294265). §5 moments, the §6 He=0 transverse law, ORIGINAL equalities including C_alg and the factor-2 accounting, the §§7-8 normalization chain and the §§2-4 premises are confirmed, and §2 states GAD faithfully. A Kac-Rice estimate matches C_alg (ratios about 1). Note (a) cautions against subtracting enclosed moments.

packets.title: C264 OrdinaryH0.lean: singular H0 naturally isomorphic to path-component coproducts, with owner repair (Math- #428)
packets.summary: Codex handoff proves naturality of Mathlib's objectwise singularHomology0Iso from zero-cycle generators, the natural iso to component-indexed coproducts, point-class separation for nonzero coefficients and a closed-superlevel difference-vanishes-iff-JoinedIn criterion. V1 failed to compile (unsolved naturality goal); the owner's rw/erw repair (successor 3d6b0d6b) elaborates with standard axioms.

packets.title: C264 OrdinaryH0Controls.lean: owner-authored instantiated ordinary-H0 control fixtures, three versions
packets.summary: Concrete Lean fixtures for ordinary H0 through the OrdinaryH0 comparison: empty space, point (nonzero augmentation, unlike reduced H0), same component in R, discrete Bool, merger Bool->Unit, projection Bool x Bool->Bool, a strict parabola superlevel inclusion, zero coefficients (H0 zero) and ZMod 2. Round-1 has 27 theorems; later versions 37 theorems, with a docstring update in the integration version.

packets.title: Round-4 Lean proof: ThetaSummable d for every d (Side24Analysis th_ lane)
packets.summary: Summability of n -> exp(-|z+24n|^2/2) over Fin d -> Z for every d, via a shift bound, one-dimensional HurwitzKernelBounds.summable_f_int and a piFinset product bound. Probe 4 sorry-free; lane file plus audit copies.
packets.already_accounted_hint: side24-coefficient (SIDE24-COEFFICIENT-D23-20260924-v1); triage wf_a3531fd8-891

packets.title: Round-4 Lean proofs: DerivativePairingBound, DerivativeBoundAtLeastOne, DerivativeBoundAtZero (dp_/d1_/d0_ lanes)
packets.summary: Iterated Frechet derivatives of the Gaussian Kinf satisfy b_{q+2} <= |x| b_{q+1} + (q+1) b_q, giving |D^q Kinf(x)u| <= exp(-|x|^2/2) pairingSum q |x| for q <= 6; corollaries 76|x|^6 e^{-|x|^2/2} for |x|>=1 and 15 at 0.
packets.already_accounted_hint: side24-coefficient (SIDE24-COEFFICIENT-D23-20260924-v1); triage wf_a3531fd8-891; main-branch UniversalLaw.Side24.pairing_sum_six, sixth_moment_double_factorial named as not reused

packets.title: Round-4 Lean proofs: ReferenceOddAndPinBlocks and ReferencePinDensityProduct (rb_/rp_ lanes)
packets.summary: Contractions of Kinf at 0 in an orthonormal frame give gradCov = 1, pinCov = diag(3,1,...,1), Var(t)=15, Cov(t,G)=(-3,0,..), tau^2=6; hence p_G(0) p_V(0) = (2pi)^(-d)/sqrt 3 for d in {2,3}. Probe 27 also tests the ReferenceCovarianceLowerBound route.
packets.already_accounted_hint: side24-coefficient (SIDE24-COEFFICIENT-D23-20260924-v1); triage wf_a3531fd8-891; main UniversalLaw.Side24.pin_determinant_and_joint_dimension named as not reused

packets.title: Round-4 Lean proofs: IntegrandRatioBounds and DensityComparison (ir_/dc_ lanes)
packets.summary: Section 4 integrand-ratio bounds with epsilon = 10^-108 and the Gaussian density comparison under a Loewner-order covariance hypothesis (1 <= M implies 1 <= det M). Probes 21-22 also contain the gradCov derivative route.
packets.already_accounted_hint: side24-coefficient (SIDE24-COEFFICIENT-D23-20260924-v1); triage wf_a3531fd8-891

packets.title: Round-4 Lean proof: LatticeImageSumBound (li_ lane)
packets.summary: Bound on the lattice-image sum of imageTerm over Fin d -> Z for d <= 3, via power-mean inequalities and piFinset product bounds; uses Side24Elementary Aux lemmas. Triage PROVABLE_WITH_WORK.
packets.already_accounted_hint: side24-coefficient (SIDE24-COEFFICIENT-D23-20260924-v1); triage wf_a3531fd8-891

packets.title: Round-4 Lean proofs: Side24 ConeMomentInterface Props ConeMomentD1Identity, TraceMoments, RayleighSquareLaw (c1_/tm_/rl_ lanes)
packets.summary: From the interface Gaussian laws: the m=1 cone moment identity, second/fourth/exponential trace moments, and P(x^2+y^2 <= a) = 1 - exp(-a/2) via polar coordinates; probe 40 shows the interface is inhabited and characterises NegDefCone.
packets.already_accounted_hint: side24-coefficient (SIDE24-COEFFICIENT-D23-20260924-v1); triage wf_a3531fd8-891

packets.title: Round-4 Lean proof: RN RareClusterPoissonObstructionO (rc_ lane)
packets.summary: Abstract implication (H1)+(H2) on (0,r0] implies the Poisson total-variation obstruction (3.1) pmfTV >= (a/2) r^3, via Markov, Poisson tail <= lam^2 and x/2 <= 1-exp(-x). Says nothing about whether H1/H2 hold for the window count.
packets.already_accounted_hint: OA-C6-RARE-CLUSTER-20260929-v1 (c6-rare-cluster PROOF.md Theorem O); triage wf_a3531fd8-891

packets.title: Round-4 provability triage of registered Props: verdict table and witness probes (Field, Lifetime, RN-A, PeriodicCoefficientInterface)

Probes kernel-check counter-witnesses: Field/Lifetime predicates are vocabulary, PairLawInterface and PeriodicCoefficientInterface do not determine the conclusions.

packets.title: P15 palette localization package: P15-A critical-threshold crosswalk, P15-C connected unbounded-width family, exact checkers and certificate inputs (recovery/session_01Cz7WZybv8znP64SpPj6sWY/scratch/p15/x/Prize_Research_P15_Palette_20260917)
packets.summary: P15-A proves a strict scalar sandwich of width kappa>=1 exists iff kappa>alpha(D), the established critical threshold value, and gives K=max(408,floor(408beta)+1) with weak-duality certificates. P15-C builds an even-cycle block family with a fixed 816-colour palette cover while alpha=m(3s-2)/(2s) is unbounded. The exact-rational Python checkers and the three JSON certificate inputs are finite companions; their source hashes match the run receipts.

packets.title: P14-B fractional resource cover (predecessor proof carried as P15 input)
packets.summary: Any exactly checked fractional row cover of normalized coefficient profiles with mass tau gives a scalar sandwich of width tau, so P14-A yields a cover at K=ceil(408 tau). It also covers weak-duality optimality certificates, componentwise/hierarchy versions and directed repair of rational proposals.

packets.title: main#350 read, code-soundness agent: independent checks of the two-parameter cusp global H0 selector (root isolation, interval enclosures, barcodes)
packets.summary: Independent sympy, mpmath and closed-form checkers for the main#350 certifying code. They cover root isolation completeness and multiplicity, interval arithmetic and field enclosure soundness, and certified H0 barcodes against the closed-form 1D persistence of -x^4/4+ux^2/2+vx. Scripts only; no outputs are retained in this batch.

packets.title: main#350 read, guards agent: re-derivation of ANALYTIC_GUARDS.md bounds (G2)-(G9)
packets.summary: Exact Fraction re-derivation of every rational guard constant and comparison with surgery_field.py. Also mpmath grid sup/inf checks of the transcendental bounds (psi' <= 4, grad chi, B1, D1, barrier, annular gradient), refutation scans at the parameter-rectangle corners, and sympy verification of the derivative identities.

packets.title: main#350 read, proof-1-5 agent: checks of PROOF.md Sections 1-5 (cusp lifetime density)
packets.summary: Exact, symbolic and numeric checks of PROOF.md Sections 1-5. They cover guards (14), (16) and (17), identities (21)-(23), (7) and (12) (K_c=4/3^(5/4)), kappa asymptotics, the edge law t^(1/3) nu(t) -> C_edge, total mass (26) and tip law (9), plus a union-find grid check of the Section 3 component claim.
packets.already_accounted_hint: main#350 head 4ccbaf62; PROOF.md sha256 9e8caa52

packets.title: main#350 read, proof-6-12 agent: numeric checks of PROOF.md Sections 6-12
packets.summary: mpmath checks of the limits (22)-(24), density formulas (6)-(9), mass (26), the physical cubic mark k(u) and normalisations (30)-(34), and C_tip eps^(7/8) scaling, using trig-form roots and an eta-form density.
packets.already_accounted_hint: main#350 head 4ccbaf62; PROOF.md sha256 9e8caa52

packets.title: main#350 review finding P15-N1: order of the error term in PROOF.md (22) and line 340
packets.summary: Two independent verifiers (symbolic root series plus 50-60 digit numerics) argue that kappa/delta^(3/2)-K_c and the gap ratio error are Theta(delta), not the stated O(sqrt delta). They give coefficients I_2=3^(-3/4)/6 (a_c^3/6) and 5sqrt3/72, and argue that (23) needs only the limits.
packets.already_accounted_hint: main#350 review finding P15-N1 (Claude S read, pickup comment 6136753955)

packets.title: main#350 review finding P15-N2: coordinate reading of B1, D1, g* in the annular exclusion (14)
packets.summary: Grid computations on the concrete member (d=2, L=1, R=1/8, r1=1/32) test whether the (G6)/(G9) guard B1 u0 + D1 v0 < g*/2 and the annular exclusion PROOF (14) hold under chart, physical and mixed coordinate readings. They also check the chart Jacobian sigma_min(dz/dy) >= 1/2.
